apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.3  (November 2026)  THE MENU AND EVERY PAGE SCROLL; A CLEAR SEARCH SIGN
  - The left menu scrolls when the window is lower than the menu (on a laptop, or with bigger letters, the pages after
    ADMIN were cut off). The version line stays at the bottom.
  - Every page (Offering Slips to Settings & Audit) scrolls when the window is lower than the page: what was hidden at
    the bottom is reached with the scroll bar or the mouse wheel. A page that fits shows no scroll bar. (The Dashboard
    already scrolled.) A list or a text box under the mouse still scrolls itself.
  - The search box has a drawn magnifying glass (the 🔍 letter was tiny on Windows); clicking it searches too.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.44.1 - THE CHILD'S BIRTH CERTIFICATE WITH A DEDICATION REQUEST (needs Website Update 109)
  - In the member portal, a parent may add the child's birth certificate to a dedication request (a photo or a PDF; it is
    optional). Only that member and the church office can see it.
  - Requests: the list has a Birth cert. column (Sent, Checked ✓). Open the request → View birth certificate (it opens in
    the computer's viewer, beside the request) → fix the spelling if needed → tick "I checked the details against the
    birth certificate" → Save changes.
  - The file is kept in Documents ▸ Certifications ▸ Birth certificates (requests) (it goes to the other computer through
    Google Drive; it is not listed in Saved certificates). Once the request is finished (Done, Not accepted, Cancelled), the
    copy in the member portal is removed; the office keeps its own.
